# Cracktab

> Cracktab is a Shopify agency with offices in Canton, Ohio (US) and Dhaka (Bangladesh). It designs and builds Shopify stores, develops custom Shopify apps, migrates stores to Shopify, and grows existing stores through ecommerce SEO and conversion rate optimization (CRO). It has worked on 170+ Shopify stores and also publishes its own apps on the Shopify App Store.

Contact: +1 (234) 901-2506 · https://cracktab.com/contact · Book a call: https://calendly.com/cracktab2025/30min

## Shopify apps by Cracktab

- [Cracktab AI SEO](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/ai-seo): free SEO app: SEO checklist, bulk meta descriptions, image compression, alt text and AI blog posts
- [Conversion Rate Optimizer](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/conversion-rate-optimizer): free app with 18 no-code conversion widgets (upsells, countdown timers, stock indicators, trust blocks) and clicks tracked per widget
- [Widgetly Reviews](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/widgetly-reviews): free photo reviews and product Q&A, with AI review import from a CSV
- [Custom Diamond Ring Builder](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/custom-diamond-ring-builder): lets shoppers build a ring step by step (setting, diamond, metal, size)
- [All apps](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps)
